newsitem.title: USA: INDIVIDUAL INVESTOR HIRES INVESTMENT BANK.
newsitem.headline: INDIVIDUAL INVESTOR HIRES INVESTMENT BANK.

text.p: Individual Investor Group Inc said Wednesday it hired Bear, Stearns & Co Inc to assist the company in exploring strategic alternatives to enhance shareholder value.
"We believe that the inherent value of our information services business in particular has yet to be fully realized by investors," said Jonathan Steinberg, chairman and chief executive officer.

"With the assistance of Bear, Stearns, we will begin to focus on alternatives such as identifying and evaluating potential strategic partners seeking minority investment positions in our businesses," Steinberg said.
Individual Investor Group publishes Individual Investor magazine, as well as other sources of investor information.
